JTP Analytics helps data-mature organisations understand what drives growth, where marketing is genuinely working, and how to make better decisions under uncertainty.

Run independently by Jake Piekarski, JTP combines rigorous statistical modelling with practical marketing experience. The focus is not simply producing another dashboard or model: it is building measurement that teams can understand, challenge and use.

## Marketing measurement built around your decisions

JTP is best suited to organisations with established data, meaningful marketing activity and questions that standard reporting cannot answer. This includes direct-to-consumer businesses, established brands, in-house marketing teams and agencies strengthening their own measurement offering across the UK and US.

The methods are designed to remain useful as access to user-level tracking and third-party cookies becomes less reliable. Aggregate modelling, experiments and causal inference provide a more durable foundation for decision-making.

## Independent expertise, explained clearly

JTP is led by [Jake Piekarski](team/index.qmd), a Principal Data Scientist at [PyMC Labs](https://www.pymc-labs.com/) with three years of agency and consultancy experience in marketing analytics. Jake has worked across Fortune 100 consumer packaged goods, airlines, manufacturing and consumer goods, food and beverage businesses, and charities.

Alongside client work, Jake contributes to the open-source [PyMC-Marketing](https://www.pymc-marketing.io/) ecosystem and has taught the [Bayesian Marketing Analytics](https://www.pymc-labs.com/courses/bayesian-marketing-analytics) course. His work combines the statistical depth needed to build credible models with the communication needed to make them useful.

[Meet Jake](team/index.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary} [Read blogs and case studies](blogs/index.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
